title: Pale Blue Dot
description: If you play enough cards in a turn, draw additional cards at the start of your next turn.
smart_description: If you play [blue]5[/blue] or more cards in a turn, draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] additional {Amount:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
notes: This power tracks card plays in a turn via ModifyHandDraw(). If the player plays 5 or more cards during their turn, they draw additional cards equal to the power's stack amount at the start of their next turn. The stack amount (Amount) determines how many extra cards are drawn.
